metadata.coordinateSystem: Local ENU mapped to Three.js [east, up, -north], meters
limitations: DEM vertical datum is not specified in source; elevations are used as supplied, without geoid correction.
Footprint roof base uses maximum DEM sample at vertices; walls extend to minimum sample for foundations.
DEM nodata cells are omitted from the terrain. Building vertices on small gaps use nearest valid samples within 100 m, counted in this report.
Imagery is optional and is a ground texture, not a source of new building geometry. No road centerlines are supplied.
Original white-model vertical semantics are not documented; it is a separate comparison layer.
